No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.

faq.q: What does Afsheen mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Afsheen is rendered افشین and carries the sense حکمران، بادشاہ، سردار.

faq.q: What does Afsheen mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Afsheen is rendered افشین and carries the sense فرمانروا، شاه، سردار.
A romanized syllable approximation is af-sheen. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Afsheen, afsheen. Script forms are افشین, अफ़शीन.

faq.q: Is Afsheen a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as unisex. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
